outcome: Fertility outcomes (implantation rate, clinical pregnancy rate)
Obstetrical outcomes (cesarean scar rupture during TOLAC)
cohort: 104 patients with secondary infertility undergoing fertility treatments after cesarean delivery
finding: While the presence of a uterine niche larger than 2 mm before conception does not appear to negatively impact future fertility, it may increase the risk of uterine rupture during trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC).
